tables.title: [Value of Railway Stocks in Divers Materials, June 4th 1921]

tables.title: [Valuation of Public Properties Claimed by Japan]

tables.title: [Sections and Dates for Completion of Chinese Police Disposition]

tables.title: Distances (Via Siberia)

review_questions: Propose a tag for distances between places, such as 'distances'.

review_questions: Propose a tag for distances between places, such as 'distances'.

tables.title: Coast Distances.—B.

review_questions: Propose a tag for distances between places, such as 'distances'.

tables.title: Distances Up the Yangtze
tables.rationale: River distances in miles between Yangtze ports. Navigation traffic is not measured, and the table is distance reference. The existing river tag centres on river description and was not clearly fitting.
review_questions: Propose a tag for distances between places, or confirm whether rivers-and-waterways applies to river distance tables.

tables.title: [Distances from Shanghai to Northern and Japanese Ports]
tables.rationale: Sea distances from Shanghai to northern and Japanese ports. No fitting detailed tag exists.
review_questions: Propose a tag for distances between places, such as 'distances'.

tables.title: [Production of Manufactured Asbestos]
tables.rationale: Output of manufactured asbestos articles by one Tientsin company. This is a manufactured product, and no asbestos or fitting manufacturing tag exists.
review_questions: Should an asbestos tag be proposed?

tables.title: Staff Returns, 1908 and 1922
tables.rationale: Postal staff by grade 1908 and 1922; employment in the postal service. No tag specifically fits postal personnel; employment-and-unemployment is not about work status or the workforce as a whole.
review_questions: Consider a tag for public-service staffing, e.g. postal personnel.

tables.title: [Nationalities of Foreign Employees]
tables.rationale: Foreign employees of the Chinese Post Office by nationality. This is a staffing breakdown, not a population subject, so nationality-and-ethnicity is not applied.
review_questions: Is a tag for postal staff or foreign employees needed?

tables.title: Small Coin Accounts
tables.rationale: Small coin account investments: fixed deposits, building and land, mortgages. Only three items, mostly deposits and property, so securities-and-investment is a weak fit.
review_questions: Is a tag for postal savings bank investments or assets needed?

tables.title: Movement of Vegetable Tallow through the Customs
tables.rationale: Customs movement of vegetable tallow, quantity and value, for 1921 and 1922. No vocabulary tag covers tallow or wax, and the table does not clearly separate imports from exports.
review_questions: Propose a tag for vegetable tallow and wax products.

tables.title: [Estimated Quantity of Walnuts Produced by Province]
tables.rationale: Estimated walnut quantities by province. Walnuts fit no specific tag; horticulture is an approximate fit but not clearly supported.
review_questions: Propose a tag for nuts or tree crops such as walnuts.

tables.title: [Western Nations in the Order of Direct Trade Dealings with China]
tables.rationale: List of Western nations with the year each first traded directly with China. It is a short chronological list, and the years are only dates. No existing tag fits it well.
review_questions: Should a tag for early foreign trade contacts be added?

tables.title: Foreign Claims
tables.rationale: Foreign claims by country and category arising from the Lincheng outrage, presented in dollars. This is an interstate claims matter; no vocabulary tag fits claims for compensation, which are distinct from treaty indemnities.
review_questions: Propose a tag for diplomatic claims or compensation for incidents.

tables.title: Military Terms
tables.rationale: Glossary of military terms with Chinese characters and romanisation; textual, not statistical. No fitting detailed tag.
review_questions: Is a tag needed for glossaries or terminology?

tables.title: Shanghai Volunteers.
tables.rationale: Active strength of the Shanghai Volunteers by unit, officers and other ranks. It is a militia of the foreign settlement; no existing tag fits a volunteer corps.
review_questions: Propose a tag for volunteer corps or militia. Should this table also carry foreign-concessions?

tables.title: Distances (Nautical Miles)
tables.rationale: Matrix of nautical-mile distances between ports on the European and Far Eastern sea routes. The subject is route distances between ports, which no existing tag covers precisely.
review_questions: Propose a tag for route or port-to-port distances; shipping and ports tags measure traffic or fleets, not distances.

tables.title: Distances (Via Siberia)
tables.rationale: Distances from London and Europe to Chinese cities by the Siberian rail-sea route. This is a route-distance table, not traffic or railway operating data.
review_questions: Propose a tag for route distances. The Moscow/Mukden value is unreadable ([?]).

tables.title: Coast Distances.—A
tables.rationale: Coastal distances in nautical miles between Shanghai and southern China ports. Only route distances are given, with no traffic or port measures.
review_questions: Propose a tag for route or port-to-port distances.

tables.title: Coast Distances.—B
tables.rationale: Coastal distances in nautical miles between Shanghai and northern China ports. Only route distances are given.
review_questions: Propose a tag for route or port-to-port distances.

tables.title: Distances up the Yangtze
tables.rationale: River distances in miles between Yangtze ports from Shanghai to Chungking, for navigation reference. The table gives distances, not river physical description, navigation traffic or cargo.
review_questions: Propose a tag for route distances. One Shasi/Shanghai value is unreadable.

tables.title: [Shanghai to Dairen, Newchwang, Vladivostok and Japanese Ports Distances]
tables.rationale: Sea distances from Shanghai to northern and Japanese ports. Only route distances are given.
review_questions: Propose a tag for route distances.

tables.title: Manufactured Asbestos
tables.rationale: Manufactured asbestos output in catties by the Tientsin Co., 1918-1923. No existing tag covers asbestos or building-material manufacture of this kind.
review_questions: Propose an asbestos or non-metallic minerals tag.

tables.title: [Percentages of Cephalic Types among the Living Population of China Proper]
tables.rationale: Percentages of cephalic (head-shape) types in the living population of China proper, a physical-anthropology measurement. No existing tag covers physical anthropology or racial type.
review_questions: Propose a tag for physical anthropology or racial characteristics; nationality-and-ethnicity was not used as the table classifies physical type, not nationality or ethnic community.

tables.title: [Classification of Mon-Khmer Aboriginal Groups]
tables.rationale: Textual classification of Mon-Khmer aboriginal groups and tribes (V. K. Ting's scheme), with no quantities. Shown as ethnological classification; it is not evidently about indigenous institutions or policy.
review_questions: Does ethnological classification of aboriginal peoples warrant indigenous-peoples, or a new tag for ethnological classification?

tables.title: [Classification of Aboriginal Races: Shan and Tibeto-Burman Groups]
tables.rationale: Textual classification of Shan and Tibeto-Burman aboriginal peoples into groups and subgroups, with no quantities. Ethnological classification only.
review_questions: Does ethnological classification of aboriginal peoples warrant indigenous-peoples, or a new tag for ethnological classification?

tables.title: [Rulers of the Manchu Dynasty]
tables.rationale: List of Manchu dynasty rulers with reign years, supporting a historical summary. The reign dates are incidental to a textual roster. The ruler succession does not match the narrower imperial-household definition (court, royal family and household institutions).
review_questions: Consider a tag for dynastic succession or ruler lists.

tables.title: [Unlabelled Column of Revenue Figures]
tables.rationale: A degraded column of revenue figures from the customs revenue section with famine relief surtax notes; labels are unreadable, but the intended quantities are statistical and the section is customs revenue. review_questions: Can the labels be recovered to confirm customs-revenue and famine-relief-surtax content?

tables.title: [Nationalities of Foreign Employees of the Chinese Post Office]
tables.rationale: Foreign employees of the Chinese Post Office by nationality. The subject is postal staff composition, so population is not added.
review_questions: Is a postal-staff tag needed? nationality-and-ethnicity was not assigned because the table counts employees, not residents.

tables.title: Income and Expenditure. 1914-23.
tables.rationale: Postal service income, working expenditure, surplus and capital expenditure, 1914-23. An operating account of the post office, so not a public budget.
review_questions: Should a tag be proposed for public enterprise accounts? public-budgets was not used because this is a service operating account.

tables.title: [Estimated Walnut Production by Province]
tables.rationale: Trade-based estimates of walnut output by province; this is a single horticultural product with no matching tag (horticulture covers fruit and garden crops but walnuts are tree nuts, borderline).
review_questions: Should a nut-crops or tree-nut tag be added? Horticulture was not assigned because walnuts are not clearly fruit/vegetable/garden crops.

tables.title: [Number of Narcotic Drug Manufacturers by Country]
tables.rationale: Counts of narcotic drug manufacturers by country, inferred from labels on seized drugs. No existing tag covers drug manufacture sources.
review_questions: Should a tag for narcotic manufacture or drug origin be added?

tables.title: Monthly Expenses of Various Governors-General
tables.rationale: Monthly expenses of offices of Governors-General; these are military-administrative offices of the central budget, with no fitting detailed tag.
review_questions: Is a tag for military-administrative offices needed? government-offices may fit if treated as civil offices.

tables.title: The Latest Concise Table of the Collections of the Peking Octroi
tables.rationale: Peking Octroi collections and monthly funds earmarked for notes, schools, judiciary and students; a local levy with no matching tag.
review_questions: Should a tag for local or octroi levies be added to the vocabulary?

tables.title: Commemoration Days of the Republic
tables.rationale: A list of commemoration dates and the republican events they mark; the content is textual. It is not a general chronology, so historical-chronologies is not assigned.
review_questions: Is a tag for public holidays or commemorations needed?

tables.title: [Budget, Commerce and Shipping of Kwangchouwan, 1923]
tables.rationale: Mixed summary of Kwangchouwan's 1923 budget, imports and exports, and steamer shipping. No single detailed tag covers it without selecting incidental components.
review_questions: Is a general territory economic-summary tag needed for budget, commerce and shipping overviews?

tables.title: [Half-yearly Index Figures, December 1913 to December 1924]
tables.rationale: Half-yearly index values from 1913 to 1924 in a currency and copper coin section. The index is not named in the table, so the subject is uncertain; the finance topic is supported by the chapter context only.
review_questions: What do the index figures measure (copper coin exchange rate?). The table title and columns do not say.

tables.title: Cost of Dollar-Coining at Nanking.
tables.rationale: Itemised daily cost of coining dollars at the Nanking mint, covering bullion, coal, wages, interest and other costs. It is an operating cost account. No existing tag fits mint operations.
review_questions: Propose a tag for mints and coinage operations.

tables.title: Financial State of the Mint When Wound Up
tables.rationale: Receipts and disbursements of the Shanghai mint when it was wound up, covering bond proceeds, land, buildings, machinery and the cash balance. It is a financial account. No existing tag fits mint accounts.
review_questions: Propose a tag for mints and coinage operations.

tables.title: Newspapers and Periodicals in Peking District (Continued)
tables.rationale: Directory of newspapers and periodicals in the Peking District (title, place, proprietor, frequency, language). Mixed newspapers and periodicals, so neither the newspapers nor the periodicals tag fits alone. The content is textual with no quantities.
review_questions: Should a combined newspapers-and-periodicals directory tag be added?

tables.title: Newspapers and Periodicals — Peking District (Continued)
tables.rationale: Textual directory of Peking District newspapers and periodicals with proprietors, frequency and language. It mixes newspapers and periodicals, so no single tag fits.
review_questions: Should a combined newspapers-and-periodicals directory tag be added?

tables.title: Fukien District
tables.rationale: Textual list of Fukien District newspapers and periodicals by place, proprietor and frequency. It is a mixed publication directory, so no single tag fits.
review_questions: Should a combined newspapers-and-periodicals directory tag be added?

tables.title: Kiangsu District — Continued
tables.rationale: Textual list of Kiangsu District newspapers and periodicals with proprietors and frequency. It is a mixed publication directory, so no single tag fits.
review_questions: Should a combined newspapers-and-periodicals directory tag be added?

tables.title: Kiangsu District.—Continued
tables.rationale: Textual list of Kiangsu and Shanghai District newspapers and periodicals, with place, proprietor and frequency. It is a mixed publication directory, so no single tag fits.
review_questions: Should a combined newspapers-and-periodicals directory tag be added?

tables.title: Shanghai District—Continued
tables.rationale: Long textual directory of Shanghai District Chinese-language periodicals and newspapers, giving place, proprietor and frequency. It is a mixed publication directory, so no single tag fits.
review_questions: Should a combined newspapers-and-periodicals directory tag be added?

tables.title: Foreign Periodicals
tables.rationale: Textual list of foreign-language newspapers and periodicals in Shanghai with editors, frequency and language. It mixes dailies and weeklies, so no single tag fits.
review_questions: Should a combined newspapers-and-periodicals directory tag be added?

tables.title: Shanghai District—Continued
tables.rationale: Textual list of Shanghai District foreign-language periodicals and newspapers with proprietors, frequency and language. It is a mixed publication directory, so no single tag fits.
review_questions: Should a combined newspapers-and-periodicals directory tag be added?

tables.title: Kwangsi District
tables.rationale: Textual list of Kwangsi District newspapers and periodicals with place, proprietor and frequency. It is a mixed publication directory, so no single tag fits.
review_questions: Should a combined newspapers-and-periodicals directory tag be added?

tables.title: Kwangtung District
tables.rationale: Large textual directory of Kwangtung District newspapers and periodicals, including a foreign section. It is a mixed publication directory, so no single tag fits.
review_questions: Should a combined newspapers-and-periodicals directory tag be added?

tables.title: [Gendarmerie in Kiangsu]
tables.rationale: Gendarmerie in Kiangsu including salt and water police units, with commanders, stations and a total of 50,000 men. Mixed military and police character; no fitting detailed tag.

tables.title: Military Terms
tables.rationale: A glossary of Chinese military terms giving English, Chinese and romanised forms. It is purely textual with no quantities. No existing tag fits a terminology glossary.
review_questions: Should a tag be added for military terminology or glossaries?

tables.title: [Types of Military and Semi-Military Organizations]
tables.rationale: Glossary of Chinese terms for military and semi-military organisations with English equivalents; textual, no quantities. No vocabulary tag covers military terminology or organisation types.

review_questions: Propose a tag for distances or sea routes.

review_questions: Propose a 'distances' tag.

tables.title: Coast Distances.—B.

review_questions: Propose a 'distances' tag.

tables.title: [Distances from Shanghai to Northern and Japanese Ports]
tables.rationale: List of sea distances from Shanghai to northern and Japanese ports. It is geographic distance data, and no existing tag covers it.
review_questions: Propose a 'distances' tag.

tables.title: [Yu Seng Co. Output]
tables.rationale: Annual output of the Yu Seng Co., 1918-1923. The product is not identified in the record, so no mineral tag is supported.
review_questions: Which mineral does the Yu Seng Co. produce? The chapter heading suggests molybdenum, bismuth, arsenic or petroleum, but none is stated in the record.

tables.title: Manufactured Asbestos
tables.rationale: Yearly production of manufactured asbestos articles by the Tientsin Company in catties; a manufactured product, not extraction.
review_questions: No existing tag fits asbestos goods; propose an asbestos or building-materials tag.

tables.title: [Cephalic Index Percentages of the Living Population of China Proper]
tables.rationale: Percentages of cephalic-index types among 1187 living people of China proper. This is a physical-anthropology measurement of the population. No vocabulary tag covers anthropometry or race measurement.
review_questions: Propose a tag for physical anthropology or anthropometric characteristics.

tables.title: Peking-Mukden (Kin-Feng) Railway
tables.rationale: Capital and invested surplus of the Peking-Mukden Railway: government capital, British and Japanese loan balances and accumulated surplus revenue. review_questions: Consider a tag for railway capital and finance accounts.

tables.title: Income and Expenditure, 1914-24.
tables.rationale: Chinese Post Office income, working expenditure, surplus and capital expenditure by year. No vocabulary tag fits postal operating accounts.
review_questions: Propose a tag for postal finances or postal accounts.

tables.title: [Foreign Postal Agencies Closed in China, 1922]
tables.rationale: Foreign postal agencies in China closed in 1922, by nationality and closure date. This reflects foreign privileges in the postal sector.
review_questions: Propose a tag for foreign post offices in China.

tables.title: Telegraph Obligations on Materials. Table B. Summary 6.
tables.rationale: Telephone materials obligations owed to suppliers (China-Japan Industrial Development Co., China Electric Co.), with unpaid principal and arrears; these are supplier credits rather than clearly loans.
review_questions: Should a tag for supplier credit or ministry obligations be added? public-debt and foreign-loans are not clearly supported.

tables.title: [Rates of Conversion into Chinese Dollars]
tables.rationale: Fixed conversion rates of foreign currencies and taels into Chinese dollars used for calculating the Ministry's debts.
review_questions: foreign-exchange denotes market rates; these are fixed accounting conversion rates, so no tag assigned.

tables.title: Imports and Exports of Bar Silver and Sycee, 1892-1924
tables.rationale: Customs totals of silver bar and sycee imports and exports, 1892-1924, are a bullion trade series with net imports. No silver tag fits because silver here is bullion trade tied to currency use, not mining or a commodity-output table.
review_questions: Should the silver tag cover bullion trade as well as mining and commodity data?

tables.title: Movement of Silver Bars to and from Shanghai during the Four Years Ended 1925
tables.rationale: Sources of silver bars reaching Shanghai over four years (imports from the U.S.A., London and Eastern ports) form a bullion import table.
review_questions: Should the silver tag cover bullion trade as well as mining and commodity data?

tables.title: Commemoration Days of the Republic
tables.rationale: Textual list of Republic of China commemoration days with dates and events; no statistical quantities. Not a dedicated chronology of general history, but it is a list of political anniversaries.
review_questions: Should a tag for public holidays or commemorations be added to the vocabulary?

tables.title: [Estimated Annual Walnut Trade by Province]
tables.rationale: Estimated annual walnut trade quantities by northern province. No tag covers walnuts or nuts, and the trade is mainly domestic and not clearly export.
review_questions: Should a tag for nuts or walnuts be added?
Is the walnut trade domestic or export?

tables.title: [Braid Winding Measurement Table]
tables.rationale: Braid winding table gives strands, turns and yards per bundle: a production measurement for straw braid. No vocabulary tag fits braid or handicraft winding specifically.
review_questions: Propose a tag for straw braid or hat-braid manufacture.

tables.title: Timber Trees of Primary Importance
tables.rationale: A list of timber tree species of Anhwei with no quantities; textual content. No tag fits species lists of timber trees (flora-and-fauna covers wild species inventories, timber covers harvested wood).
review_questions: Propose a tag for commercial tree species.

tables.title: [Principal Dimensions of the Fushun]
tables.rationale: Gives the technical specifications of one river steamer, the Fushun: dimensions, deadweight, complement and speed. It is quantitative, but no vocabulary tag covers an individual vessel's specifications.
review_questions: Should a tag be added for individual vessel specifications or the ship fleet?

tables.title: [Principal Dimensions of the s.s. Taishan]
tables.rationale: Gives the dimensions of one steamer, the Taishan. No tag fits the specification of a single vessel.
review_questions: Should a tag be added for individual vessel specifications?

tables.title: Revolutionary or Outlaw Units.

review_questions: Should irregular or outlaw armed bands be tagged banditry or a new warlord-forces term?

tables.title: Shanghai Volunteers
tables.rationale: Shanghai Volunteers active units by officers and other ranks; a volunteer defence force of the foreign settlement. No fitting detailed tag for volunteer corps; not clearly army or foreign garrison.
review_questions: Propose a tag for volunteer forces/militia.

tables.title: Distances (Nautical Miles)

review_questions: Propose a tag for distance tables or routes.

review_questions: Propose a tag for distance tables or routes.

tables.rationale: Overland and sea distances via Siberia from London to Shanghai.
review_questions: Propose a tag for distance tables or routes.

review_questions: Propose a tag for distance tables or routes.

tables.title: Coast Distances.—B.
tables.rationale: Coastal sea distances between Shanghai and northern ports.
review_questions: Propose a tag for distance tables or routes.

tables.title: [Cephalic Index Percentages of the Living Population of China Proper]
tables.rationale: Percentage distribution of cephalic index types among the living population of China proper, a physical-anthropological classification. No existing tag covers physical anthropology.
review_questions: Propose a tag for physical anthropology or racial classification? nationality-and-ethnicity was not used because no nationality or ethnic groups are given.

tables.title: [Production of Asbestos Articles by the Tientsin Co.]
tables.rationale: Output of manufactured asbestos articles by the Tientsin company; no asbestos or building-materials tag fits.
review_questions: Propose a tag for asbestos or non-metallic mineral products.

tables.title: [Glass Sand Deposits in China]
tables.rationale: Descriptive list of glass sand deposit localities, province, deposit type and remarks; content is textual. No sand or glass-sand tag exists in the vocabulary.
review_questions: Propose a tag for non-metallic minerals such as glass sand and abrasives.

tables.title: Movement of Silver to and from China
tables.rationale: Annual silver imports into China by bars and coin, with net imports, compiled from Maritime Customs. This is trade in silver as a bullion commodity and in coin. The vocabulary has no tag for general bullion or specialie movements; silver/imports tags would be weak since the table covers both directions of flow.
review_questions: Should a tag for specie or bullion movements be added? The existing silver tag is for mining and commodity data, and imports alone does not cover the table's two-way flows.

tables.title: Chinese Post Office Savings Bank Account for the Year 1925 (Including Working Expenses)
tables.rationale: Receipts account of the Post Office Savings Bank for 1925: interest, exchange gains and fees, and a drawing from the Postal Advance Account. It is a financial account of a postal savings institution.
review_questions: Is a tag for institutional financial accounts or operating accounts needed? Existing tags (savings-and-loans, banking) fit only partly.

tables.title: Profit and Loss Account for the Year 1925
tables.rationale: Profit and loss account of the Post Office Savings Bank for 1925: interest paid, exchange losses, charges and working expenses.
review_questions: Is a tag for institutional financial accounts or operating accounts needed? Existing tags (savings-and-loans, banking) fit only partly.

tables.title: Chinese Post Office Savings Bank, Profit and Loss Account, 1925 (Continued)
tables.rationale: Continued Post Office Savings Bank profit and loss account for small coin currency, with an interest and exchange account.
review_questions: Is a tag for institutional financial accounts or operating accounts needed? Existing tags (savings-and-loans, banking) fit only partly.

tables.title: Distribution of the Autumn-Festival Treasury Notes
tables.rationale: Distribution of treasury notes by face value among military, police, navy, education and foreign-affairs recipients; a financial instrument allocation. No tag exactly fits note issuance or allocation (public-budgets and public-debt are not clearly supported).

tables.title: Obligations Contracted in Respect of Materials Supplied
tables.rationale: Obligations of the Ministry of Communications to named companies for materials supplied (telegraph loan items). These are debts, but they are commercial supplier obligations, not public bonds or foreign loans in the tag sense. No existing tag cleanly fits.

tables.title: Indebtedness of Ministry of Communications
tables.rationale: Obligations for materials and supplies purchased for railway lines from Chinese firms, banking groups and Hanyehping. These are supplier and advance obligations, not clearly covered by an existing tag.
review_questions: Propose a tag for government obligations or arrears for supplies; public-debt may be arguable.

tables.title: [Domestic Loans for Telegraph Materials]
tables.rationale: Domestic loans from named firms for telegraph materials supplied to the Ministry; supplier obligations with no precisely fitting tag.
review_questions: Propose a tag for supplier obligations; public-debt may be arguable.

tables.title: [Principal Dimensions of the Hongkong Firefloat]

tables.title: [Strands, Turns and Yards per Bundle of Strawbraid]

review_questions: Should a tag for nuts or tree crops be added?

tables.title: Assessment Increases on New Valuation for Year Commencing 1st July 1925
tables.rationale: Increases in rateable value by district after a new property valuation for rates assessment. The subject is local rates, which is a tax measure, but the table gives assessment values rather than receipts.
review_questions: Should a tag for local property rates or valuation be added? The taxation tag covers assessment but this table has no tax receipts or rates.

tables.title: Commemoration Days of the Republic
tables.rationale: Short list of Republic commemoration dates and the events they mark; textual. No existing tag covers public holidays or commemorations.
review_questions: Propose a tag for public holidays and commemorations.

tables.title: Military Terms
tables.rationale: Glossary of Chinese military terms with characters and romanisation. It is textual reference content covering offices, branches and units.
review_questions: Propose a vocabulary term for military terminology or glossaries.

tables.title: [Types of Military Organizations Under Which Armed Men Classify Themselves]
tables.rationale: Text list of irregular and semi-military organisation names with English equivalents, such as guards, constabulary and bandit suppression units. No single existing tag covers this mixed set.
review_questions: Propose a tag for irregular or local armed forces and military terminology.

tables.title: Shanghai Volunteers
tables.rationale: Strength of Shanghai Volunteer Corps units by nationality of company, in the foreign-run settlement; no tag covers volunteer or militia forces.
review_questions: Propose a tag for volunteer corps or militia.

tables.title: [Contributors acknowledged in the Preface]
tables.rationale: Preface list of contributors and the subjects they wrote; textual acknowledgements with no statistical content. No existing tag fits the publication's own editorial credits.
review_questions: Propose a tag for book front matter or editorial credits.

tables.title: Distances (Nautical Miles)
tables.rationale: Nautical distance matrices between ports and places; the figures are distances, not areas, physical features or traffic. No suitable detailed tag exists.
review_questions: Propose a tag for distances and routes.

tables.title: [Cephalic indices of the living population of China proper]
tables.rationale: Percentages of head-shape types (cephalic indices) among 1187 living people of China proper; anthropometric characteristics of the population.
review_questions: No tag covers physical anthropology; propose 'physical-anthropology'.

tables.title: [Tentative conclusions regarding the physical traits of the Chinese]
tables.rationale: Textual conclusions about physical traits of the Chinese from anthropometric data; narrative, not quantities.
review_questions: No tag covers physical anthropology; propose 'physical-anthropology'.

tables.title: [Rulers of the Manchu dynasty]
tables.rationale: List of Manchu dynasty rulers with reign years; textual roster with incidental dates. No tag fits for a ruler list (imperial-household concerns court/household, not reign lists).
review_questions: Consider a vocabulary term for rulers and dynastic lists.

tables.title: [Medicines and allied products of China]
tables.rationale: A list of medicinal and allied products of China (alum, musk, rhubarb etc.) with no quantities; a textual product inventory. Fits trade/products loosely.
review_questions: Consider a tag for medicinal products or materia medica; pharmaceuticals may not fit raw natural products.

tables.title: [Subjects of the entrance examination, Judicial Officers' Training School]
tables.rationale: List of entrance-examination subjects for the Judicial Officers' Training School; textual numbered list. No existing tag fits judicial officer training exactly.
review_questions: Propose a tag for legal or judicial training (judicial officers' training).

tables.title: [Curriculum of the Judicial Officers' Training School]
tables.rationale: Textual list of courses in the Judicial Officers' Training School curriculum; no statistics. No existing tag fits legal professional training.
review_questions: Propose a tag for legal or judicial training (judicial officers' training).

tables.title: [Kwangchouwan government and services]
tables.rationale: Textual directory of Kwangchouwan officials and services (governor, police, medical, education, post, banks). Content is descriptive text with few quantities (500 guards, one company). No single detailed tag fits the multi-function list; colonial-administration is not clearly established as the subject beyond a directory of offices.
review_questions: Should a French leased-territory administration directory receive colonial-rule/colonial-administration? Proposed: a tag for leased-territory administration.

tables.title: [Governmental groups in China and their territorial control, early 1928]
tables.rationale: Textual outline of rival governmental groups and the provinces they controlled in 1928. No existing tag covers political factions or warlord territorial control.
review_questions: Propose a tag for regional political and military factions/warlord control.

tables.title: [Persons present at the Disbandment Conference, January 15, 1929]
tables.rationale: Names of persons present at the Disbandment Conference of January 1929; a participant list. Disbandment of armies is the subject, but only names are listed.
review_questions: Vocabulary has no tag for political conferences or party congresses; propose one?

tables.title: [Initial measures of the Ministry of Health]
tables.rationale: Textual list of initial measures of the Ministry of Health (national board, laboratory, health officer training, maritime quarantine). Mixed items, none dominant enough for a single tag.
review_questions: Would a health-administration tag be proposed for public health policy lists?

tables.title: Proportion Borne by the Share of Each Nationality to the Whole Trade, 1927
tables.rationale: Percentage shares by flag of tonnage, foreign and coast trade, and customs revenue (duties and tonnage dues). Mixes trade, shipping and revenue shares by nationality of vessel; no single tag fits all without forcing one component.
review_questions: Consider a tag for carrying trade by flag/nationality of shipping.

tables.title: [Mongols outside Mongolia]
tables.rationale: Textual enumeration of Mongol groups outside Mongolia with the authorities supervising them; mostly ethnic and administrative description. No existing tag fits well.
review_questions: Is a tag for Mongol banners and tribal groups needed?

tables.title: [Yangtze River Commission: Technical Committee members, 1922]
tables.rationale: A list of seven Technical Committee members of the Yangtze River Commission with a chairman; the content is purely textual personnel. No existing tag covers river commission membership precisely.
review_questions: Consider a tag for river commission organisation or personnel.

tables.title: [Yangtze River Commission: personnel of the new Technical Committee]
tables.rationale: A roster of the new Yangtze River Commission Technical Committee with advisers noted. The content is textual personnel for a river conservancy body.
review_questions: Consider a tag for river commission organisation or personnel.

tables.title: [Ratio of loss on conversion of copper-cent income into dollars, Shanghai Tramways, 1909-1928]
tables.rationale: Ratio of loss on converting copper-cent income into dollars for Shanghai Tramways; a company's monetary conversion loss. Tram content is incidental, and no existing tag fits the subject.
review_questions: Propose a tag for currency-conversion losses of a company, or confirm currency-related coverage.

tables.title: Income and Expenditure, 1924-1927
tables.rationale: Post office income, working expenditure, surplus and capital expenditure by year. This is a postal operating account, and no vocabulary tag covers it.
review_questions: Should a tag for postal finance or public enterprise accounts be added?

tables.title: [Closure of foreign postal agencies in China]
tables.rationale: Foreign postal agencies in China (British, French, American, Japanese) closed after the Washington Conference, with counts and closure dates. This shows foreign privileges ending; the postal-service tag is not used.
review_questions: Should a tag for foreign postal agencies or privileges be added?

tables.title: Distribution of Farms
tables.rationale: Counts of surveyed farms by town on the Chengtu Plain; a sample distribution, not tenure or production. No existing tag covers farm survey sampling.
review_questions: Propose a tag for farm surveys or sample distribution.

tables.title: Labour Costs and Income
tables.rationale: Paid and unpaid labour costs and income from labour for renters, part-owners and owners on surveyed farms. Costs of farm labour are not wages in a standard sense and no tag fits well.
review_questions: Propose a tag for farm labour costs or farm income; wages is a doubtful fit as it mixes paid and unpaid labour.

tables.title: Special Commissioners for Foreign Affairs
tables.rationale: List of provincial Special Commissioners for Foreign Affairs by province and seat. These are domestic officials handling foreign affairs, not diplomatic missions abroad.
review_questions: Should a tag be added for foreign affairs commissioners or local foreign-affairs offices?

tables.title: Commissioners for Foreign Affairs
tables.rationale: List of Commissioners for Foreign Affairs by place, including Hankow special district directors. It is a roster of officials without a fitting detailed tag.
review_questions: Should a tag be added for local foreign-affairs commissioners?

tables.title: Military Terms
tables.rationale: Glossary of English, Chinese and romanized military terms; textual reference list with no quantities.
review_questions: Vocabulary lacks a tag for glossaries or terminology.

tables.title: Shanghai Volunteers
tables.rationale: Strength of the Shanghai Volunteer Corps by unit and nationality in the foreign-administered Shanghai settlement. It is a volunteer force, not clearly a regular army, and no tag fits exactly.
review_questions: Propose a tag for volunteer or municipal defence forces.
Is the informal-imperialism topic sufficiently evidenced by the table itself?

tables.title: General Data
tables.rationale: Hull dimensions of U.S. gunboats Guam and Tutuila in the shipbuilding section; these are technical specifications. No tag fits well, since this is neither shipbuilding output nor a fleet count.
review_questions: Should a tag for ship design specifications be added? Is the shipbuilding tag meant to cover this?

tables.title: Principal Dimensions
tables.rationale: Principal dimensions of the Chinese Navy gunboat Hsein Ning in the shipbuilding section; a technical specification of a single vessel.
review_questions: Should a vessel-specification tag be added? Does the military navy tag apply to a single gunboat's build data?

tables.title: [Ordnance of the gunboat Hsein Ning]
tables.rationale: Lists the armament of the gunboat Hsein Ning (guns by number and type), which is naval ordnance.
review_questions: Does the arms-and-arsenals tag cover the armament of a single vessel?

tables.title: Progressive Trials
tables.rationale: Progressive trial results (speed, horsepower, boiler pressure, vacuum, slip, revolutions per minute) for the gunboat Hsein Ning; technical engineering data.
review_questions: Should a tag for ship trials or engineering performance be added?

tables.title: Sea, Coast and River Distances
tables.rationale: Matrix of nautical distances between ports from London to the Far East. No existing tag covers distance tables.
review_questions: Propose a tag for distance tables or routes?

tables.title: Sea, Coast and River Distances
tables.rationale: Nautical distances between Shanghai, Japanese and Pacific ports, Panama and New York. No fitting tag.
review_questions: Propose a tag for distance tables or routes?

tables.title: Distances (via Siberia)
tables.rationale: Distances via Siberia between European, Manchurian and Chinese places. No fitting tag.
review_questions: Propose a tag for distance tables or routes?

tables.title: Coast Distances—A
tables.rationale: Coast distances between Shanghai and southern ports. No fitting tag.
review_questions: Propose a tag for distance tables or routes?

tables.title: Coast Distances—B
tables.rationale: Coast distances between Shanghai and northern ports. No fitting tag.
review_questions: Propose a tag for distance tables or routes?

tables.title: [Rulers of the Manchu Dynasty]
tables.rationale: Roster of Manchu Dynasty rulers with reign years. The reign dates are incidental, so the table is textual. No existing detailed tag fits (imperial-household concerns the court and royal family, not a list of reigns).
review_questions: Should a dynastic rulers or reign list tag be added? Existing tags do not fit well.

tables.title: Commerce 1930
tables.rationale: Macao's 1930 imports, exports and total trade values; a trade summary. Imports and exports are both shown, but no single tag fits better than the topic alone.

tables.title: [Amoy Cash Balance]
tables.rationale: A single cash balance figure for the Amoy settlement. It has no revenue or expenditure flows, so it is not a public-budget table.
review_questions: Is a vocabulary term needed for cash balances or public accounts that are not budget flows?

tables.title: Central Field Health Station
tables.rationale: Budget for the Central Field Health Station covering maintenance, equipment, buildings, hospital and schools; a health-administration budget. No existing tag fits a health-specific budget precisely, and public-budgets would be broad.
review_questions: Propose a tag for health administration budgets or institutions.

tables.title: [Pyrite Production in Liaoning Province]
tables.rationale: Pyrite output at three Liaoning mines, 1929-1930; no existing tag covers pyrite.
review_questions: Propose a pyrite or sulphur-minerals tag.

tables.title: [Stocks of Silver in Shanghai at End of Each Quarter]
tables.rationale: Quarterly silver stocks held in Shanghai, in taels and dollars. This is a financial/bullion stock measure with no exactly fitting tag; the currency tag is not clearly established.
review_questions: Should a tag for bullion or silver stocks in financial markets be added?

tables.title: [Trade Figures for Wuchow, Nanning, Kiungchow and Pakhoi]
tables.rationale: Trade values for four ports with unlabeled columns; it is unclear whether they are exports or imports, so neither tag is assigned.
review_questions: Are these figures exports, imports or total trade, and which years do the columns cover?

tables.title: South Manchuria Railway Company General Balance Sheet — Assets
tables.rationale: Company balance sheet assets of the South Manchuria Railway as at 31 March 1931: fixed assets, investments, current assets, depreciation. Company accounts; the 'companies' tag is meant for corporate organisation and results, but this is a single-company balance sheet with railway, mining and other enterprise assets.
review_questions: Should a tag be added for the accounts or balance sheets of a single company?

tables.title: South Manchuria Railway Company General Balance Sheet — Liabilities
tables.rationale: Liabilities side of the South Manchuria Railway balance sheet showing subscribed capital stock held by the Japanese government and the public, paid up and uncalled.
review_questions: Should a tag be added for company capital stock and shareholding?

tables.title: Liabilities (Continued)
tables.rationale: Continuation of the South Manchuria Railway liabilities: reserves, bonds, current liabilities, deposits and net profit. Corporate accounts.
review_questions: Should a tag be added for the accounts or balance sheets of a single company?

tables.title: Profit and Loss Account
tables.rationale: Profit and loss account of the South Manchuria Railway Company by department: railroad, harbours, collieries, oil distillation, iron works, with income, expenditure and net profit. Company operating accounts.
review_questions: Should a tag be added for the accounts or balance sheets of a single company?

tables.title: Disposition of Net Profit
tables.rationale: Appropriation of a railway's net profit to reserves, dividends on government and public stock, bonuses and balance carried forward. These are company operating accounts. The tag 'companies' is not clearly supported, and the railway is not identified in the record.
review_questions: Which railway is this? The record does not name it. A tag for railway company accounts or dividends may be needed.

tables.title: [Depreciation, Depletion, etc. Charged to Accounts]
tables.rationale: Note showing how the depreciation and depletion charge was allocated between profit and loss and suspense accounts. It is a company accounting item. No existing tag covers it.
review_questions: Should a tag for company accounts or depreciation be proposed?

tables.title: General Balance Sheet of the China Foundation for the Promotion of Education and Culture
tables.rationale: Balance sheet of the China Foundation for education and culture, funded from the Boxer Indemnity; assets, endowment funds and liabilities. No tag fits an institutional balance sheet of a foundation.
review_questions: Propose a tag for foundation or endowment accounts.

tables.title: Loans
tables.rationale: Cash and material loans made by the Board of Trustees from the Boxer Indemnity fund to a conservancy board and railways. No tag fits domestic loans from an indemnity fund.
review_questions: Propose a tag for loans made from an indemnity or trust fund.
